name: pi-cliproxiapi-auth
description: Pi-mono (omp) extension for CLIProxyAPI — connect, /v1/models discovery, models.json + models.dev enrichment

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/normalizer.test.mjs test/models.test.mjs test/models-json.test.mjs test/models-dev.test.mjs test/logger.test.mjs test/config-store.test.mjs test/extension.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && CLIPROXY_INTEGRATION=1 node --test test/integration.test.mjs
scripts.check:exports: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/index.js').then((m)=>{if(typeof m.default!=='function'){throw new Error('Default export must be a function (OMP extension factory)');}})"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check:exports

author: Ruslan Gainanov
